limitations: Proposed task-local prototype only; it does not alter canonical labels, the selected rule hash, or production generator dispatch.
The setting space is deliberately bounded to four nearby rules and does not establish uniqueness against undeclared hypotheses.
Evidence uses one deterministic four-pair episode per setting; broader seed coverage would be required before training admission.
The previous-marker variant preserves each current marker cell and colors only the open interval above it, matching the retained semantic rival.
program:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (reduce (lambda (acc c)
                     (let* ((marks (filter (lambda (r) (!= (at g r c) 0)) (range 0 h))))
                       (if (or
                             (empty? marks)
                             (empty? (filter (lambda (r) (= (at g r c) 5)) marks)))
                           acc
                           (reduce (lambda (a i)
                                     (let* ((r (nth marks i))
                                            (start (if (zero? i)
                                                       0
                                                       (+ (nth marks (- i 1)) 1)))
                                            (color (if (zero? i)
                                                       (at g r c)
                                                       (at g (nth marks (- i 1)) c)))
                                            (stop (if (zero? i)
                                                      (+ r 1)
                                                      r)))
                                       (reduce (lambda (aa rr) (set-cell aa rr c color))
                                               a
                                               (range start stop))))
                                   acc
                                   (range 0 (length marks))))))
                   g
                   (range 0 w)))))
